description: Unsigned transactions for one CantorFi action, ready to be signed and sent in order by the user's or the agent's own wallet: a vault action (supply, borrow, repay, withdraw), staking of the vault receipt token CVT (stake with a lock of 1 to 365 days, unstake once the lock has ended, claim_rewards), or a swap between USDC, WETH and ETH through the CantorFi router with a minimum received. Nothing is signed or sent by this server.

amount.description: Amount in token units (CVT for stake, the sold token for swap), digits with an optional decimal point, for example 25.5

lockDays.description: Lock of a stake in days, 30 by default (stake)

slippage.description: Accepted price move in percent, 1 by default (swap)

vault.description: Token symbol, vault id or vault address (vault actions and staking)

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that will sign and send

name: cantorfi_prepare
title: Prepare a CantorFi transaction
